input.quote: Garman agrees to indemnify Sparkling and hold it harmless from any and all losses, damages and expenses including without limitation, court costs, arbitration fees, penalties, fines, amounts paid in settlement of claims and reasonable legal fees and expenses of investigation (collectively the \"Losses\") which Sparkling or any of its respective officers or directors may incur due to a breach of this warranty.
input.rationale: Section 13's only indemnity is for Losses arising from breach of Garman's title/rights warranty; there is no express defence obligation, no coverage of third-party infringement claims as such (nor of Garman's breach of law, Garman-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct), and no defence procedure. The injunction remedies in (a)-(c) are procure/modify/replace only, with no refund if none is available, so the clause also falls short of the fallback remedy set. We therefore target the preferred position by inserting a single express Garman defence-and-indemnity paragraph with notice, control and cooperation mechanics, and confirming that any Sparkling indemnity is limited to Sparkling-provided content and Sparkling's breach of law. We deliberately do not import the fallback's 3x-annual-fees super-cap or Customer modification/combination/specification exclusions, since Section 15 already carves Section 13 out of the liability limitation and the agreement contains no such exclusions - both positions are better for us than the fallback allows.

proposal.summary: Add express Garman defence/indemnity for third-party IP, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct claims, with notice/control/cooperation procedure, and cap any Sparkling indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need Garman to defend and indemnify us and our affiliates against third-party claims (IP infringement, Garman's breach of law, Garman-caused data breach, gross negligence or wilful misconduct), with the usual notice, control and cooperation mechanics; the current Section 13 only indemnifies losses from breach of the title warranty. We have also confirmed that any Sparkling indemnity stays limited to our own content and breach of law.

ops.text: Garman shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Sparkling and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting Losses, to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Work or the Maintenance Services infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (ii) Garman's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Sparkling's data caused by Garman; or (iv) Garman's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Sparkling shall notify Garman in writing of any such claim, Garman shall have control of the defence and settlement of the claim, and Sparkling shall provide reasonable cooperation in that defence. Sparkling's indemnification obligations under this Agreement, if any, are limited to claims arising from content provided by Sparkling and Sparkling's breach of applicable law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
